text:
alice: starting canary for runtime v3.2 (kernel batching + eviction tweaks) -> 10% traffic on cg-7. router header-swap (x-rd-route) enabled for canary. pinning api to v2.9 for this wave. rolling window 23:00-01:00 UTC. shout if we need immediate rollback.

ben: watching console dashboards, I'll mute autoscale if p95 climbs.

deploy-bot: deploy initiated: runtime:v3.2 -> cg-7 (10%). change_id=dbb-1768820000. router-change scheduled.

dana: heads-up: v3.2 flips KV eviction to "aggressive" by default. staging looked ok but long-lived sessions might see more cold misses.

alice: correct. eviction aggressive=true to free KV for batching. validated on perf tests but real traffic has differences.

eric: created alerts: latency_p50>220ms for 3m OR error_rate>0.8% (3m) => paging threshold. @sre-bot please register.

sre-bot: alert added and routed to #eng-oncall per eric.

ben: small spike of 502s from router -> runtime in logs, ~00:02 into canary.

ben: log snippet:
`router: upstream 502 from runtime-cg7 inst-12 session=abc123 header_x_rd_route=canary`
`api: 2024-11-02T23:02:14Z trace=tx-1204`

dana: that matches a known kernel race where late-arriving KV slices cause protocol timeouts when header-swapped.

alice: pause traffic shift to canary at 0% while we investigate. ben, issue pause.

deploy-bot: traffic_shift pause acknowledged by alice. canary traffic -> 0% (ETA 6s). status=paused.

eric: recommend toggling router behavior back to preserve previous header handling for canary routes until kernel patch.

ben: flipping router flag on canary env: `routerctl set-flag x-rd-route-preserve=true --env canary`. ETA ~20s.

dana: meanwhile I'll revert KV eviction on cg-7 to staging defaults and run a quick smoke.

alice: new rollback gates: if p50>220ms for 5m OR 502 rate >0.8% for 3m we auto-rollback. update release notes and pin docs.

ben: updated release notes: "runtime v3.2: batching+eviction changes. Router header-swap experimental; disabled for canary until compatibility validated." linked runbook: runbooks/runtime-v3.2-compat.md

deploy-bot: snapshot created snapshot-1768820000-rollback. runtime:v3.2 instances draining. api:v2.9 pin intact.

eric: I'll monitor alerts and escalate to incident channel if thresholds hit.

dana: starting staging kernel patch tests now, will report in ~30m.

alice: thanks. decision recap: hold canary, flip router preserve flag, revert eviction on canary runtime, validate patch in staging, then resume. keep notes concise for ops.

ben: added short checklist to release: 1) router flag, 2) eviction toggle, 3) kernel patch smoke, 4) resume canary.

alice: perfect. will reconvene before resuming traffic shift.
